css:
<style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  body, html {
    font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    background: #fff;
    width: 80mm;
  }

  .rw {
    width: 80mm;
    margin: 0 auto;
    font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: #1a1a1a;
  }

  .hdr {
    padding: 10px 10px 8px;
    text-align: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #fafafa 100%);
  }

  .hdr-logo-wrap {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .hdr-logo-wrap img {
    height: 42px;
    width: auto;
    display: block;
    filter: contrast(1.05);
  }

  .hdr-name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
    color: #111;
    text-shadow: 0 0.5px 0 #fff;
  }

  .hdr-divider {
    width: 36px;
    border: none;
    border-top: 1px solid #bbb;
    margin: 4px auto 5px;
  }

  .hdr-tag {
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #666;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .hdr-web {
    font-size: 8px;
    color: #555;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  .bd { padding: 0 8px; }

  .sec  { padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted #d5d5d5; }
  .secs { padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a; }
  .secl { padding: 6px 0; }

  .sl {
    font-size: 7px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #888;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
  }

  .r2 { display: table; width: 100%; }
  .cl { display: table-cell; vertical-align: top; width: 60%; }
  .crr { display: table-cell; vertical-align: top; text-align: right; width: 40%; }

  .sb {
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff 0%, #f5f5f5 100%);
    color: #1a1a1a;
    font-size: 7px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    display: inline-block;
    border-radius: 1px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }

  .mu { color: #444; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .di { color: #777; font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.5; }

  .on { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

  .it { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 10px; }
  .it thead th {
    font-size: 7.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #555;
    padding: 0 0 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #aaa;
  }
  .it tbody td { padding: 3px 0 2px; vertical-align: top; word-break: break-word; }
  .it tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px dotted #e5e5e5; }
  .it tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .ci  { width: 48%; text-align: left; }
  .cq  { width: 10%; text-align: center; }
  .cr2 { width: 19%; text-align: right; }
  .ca  { width: 23%; text-align: right; }

  .in { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; }
  .ig { font-size: 8px; color: #777; margin-top: 1px; }

  .tt { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 10px; }
  .tt td { padding: 2px 0; vertical-align: top; }
  .tt td:last-child { text-align: right; }
  .tt .ml { color: #555; }
  .tt .ms { color: #444; font-size: 9px; }

  .gt td {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 5px 0 3px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f9f9f9 100%);
    border-top: 1px solid #ccc;
  }

  .iw {
    font-size: 7.5px;
    text-align: right;
    font-style: italic;
    color: #666;
    padding: 2px 0 0;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .ftw {
    padding: 8px 0 6px;
    text-align: center;
    border-top: 1px dotted #d5d5d5;
    margin-top: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(0deg, #ffffff 0%, #fcfcfc 100%);
  }

  .ft  {
    font-size: 7.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #444;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .ft2 {
    font-size: 7px;
    color: #999;
    margin-top: 5px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .qr-wrap {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .qr-wrap img {
    width: 70px;
    height: 70px;
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #fff;
    padding: 2px;
    border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  @media print {
    @page { size: 80mm auto; margin: 0; }
    html, body { width: 80mm; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    .rw { width: 80mm; }
    .hdr, .sb, .gt td, .ftw { 
      -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
      print-color-adjust: exact;
      box-shadow: none; 
    }
  }
</style>
